audit.whatIsWrong: The lane was described as a generic 'fighter tax' with no named window.
audit.why: Shield Vault is a 600-range point-and-click dash-stun on 13s at rank 1, dropping to 9s. That cooldown is the entire early lane — it is the only thing that reaches you.
audit.corrected: Hard at 8/10 because Shield Vault comes back every 13 to 9 seconds and there is no dodging a point-and-click dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart disagreed across layers on three rows — phases[4] and phases[5] read Pantheon while win[4] and win[5] read Kassadin, and phases[6] read 'Skill' against win[6] Kassadin. Separately whys[3] claimed levels 4-5 flip to Kassadin while win[3] said Pantheon.
audit.why: The packet chart gives Pantheon the first four stages and Kassadin the last three, which matches Riftwalk at 6 and Pantheon's flat scaling.
audit.corrected: phases[4], [5], [6] set to Kassadin; whys[3] rewritten to keep levels 4-5 with Pantheon so it stops contradicting win[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent. Aegis Assault only makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT. Aegis Assault is a channel and Null Sphere explicitly interrupts channels. Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up — not the cast — is the tell.
audit.why: All three come straight from Riot's ability text: 'invulnerable to damage from the front', Null Sphere 'interrupting channels', and Shield Vault's auto-reset flag.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk behind him and Aegis Assault stops protecting him; or simply Null Sphere the channel to end it. And read the Shield Vault wind-up, because the auto reset means the damage arrives before the animation reads as finished.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number in it.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9, Aegis Assault 22 down to 18, Grand Starfall 180/165/150 at 5500 range.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in, with Shield Vault named as the one that gates every step-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Grand Starfall is a 5500-range global on a 180-second cooldown at rank 1.
audit.why: It means a Pantheon who leaves lane after 6 is usually not roaming on foot, and a shoved wave is the setup for it.
audit.corrected: After 6, a Pantheon who disappears has a 5500-range leap available; ping it before your side lanes overextend.

audit.why: 52.12% across 424 games matches a lane conceded and a game scaled into.

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged wants.foe[1] 'Use Aegis Assault' as a probable wrong name. It is a FALSE POSITIVE — Aegis Assault is Pantheon's real E; the checker measured distance against the 'Use ' prefix. I rewrote the line anyway for content, not for the name. Chart: full-layer rows 4, 5 and 6 moved to Kassadin to match win[4..6] which were already correct, and content whys[3] was rewritten because it contradicted its own win[3]. Ratings left untouched. Whether Aegis Assault's front-only invulnerability tracks Pantheon's facing continuously or is locked at cast time is not in Riot's text, so I wrote only that it blocks from the front.
